| Method | What to do |
|--------|------------|
| **IndiGo Mobile App** | Open the app → “My Bookings” → select the booking ID `IND4567`. You’ll see the current status, gate information, and any delays. |
| **Website** | Go to [indigo.in](https://www.indigo.in/), log into your account, then click *“View My Booking.”* Enter the ticket number (`IND4567`) and press search. |
| **SMS / Email Confirmation** | Check the confirmation SMS/email you received when booking – it usually contains a link or QR code that leads straight to the status page. |
| **Customer Support** | Call IndiGo Customer Care at +91 11 4600 0000 (or use the chat feature on their site) and give them the ticket number. They can confirm departure time, terminal, boarding gates, and any changes. |

If you’re near the airport, most terminals also display real‑time board updates where you can look up the flight number (e.g., `IAK123`).

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with—happy travels!
